project_type: FastAPI Python service with PostgreSQL persistence
build_system: pip with pyproject.toml, editable install with pip install -e .
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests, httpx for API testing
verification_instructions: Run pytest with -v flag. All tests must pass. Integration tests use test_db_session fixture with SQLite (fast) or TEST_DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL (real PostgreSQL). Service must start with valid JWT_SECRET_KEY environment variable.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. All code is source code, no generated files to commit.
environment_constraints: Requires DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL for PostgreSQL connection (uses asyncpg driver). JWT_SECRET_KEY required at startup (≥32 chars). Never use create_all() for schema changes — only Drizzle migrations.
contribution_requirements: R4 builds on R1-R3: R1 (repository intelligence), R2 (seal_contract + ContractFieldEvidence), R3 (PostgreSQL ContractRepository with hash verification). Must use existing repository pattern with Depends() injection. Must call session.commit() after repository writes. Must verify hash integrity on contract reads.
key_patterns: Repository pattern: async def endpoint(repo: ContractRepository = Depends(get_contract_repository), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session)). Auth pattern: user: dict = Depends(require_contract_admin). Test pattern: @pytest_asyncio.fixture for async fixtures, test_db_session from conftest.py for integration tests. Error handling: raise HTTPException(status_code=..., detail=...). JWT: python-jose library, HS256 algorithm, Bearer token in Authorization header.
directory_structure: services/project-ai/app/ contains main.py (FastAPI app), api/routes/ (route modules), contracts/ (R2 contract logic), persistence/ (R3 repositories + models), auth/ (will create for R4). tests/ contains conftest.py (shared fixtures), unit/ (mocked tests), integration/ (real DB tests). No middleware/ directory yet — R4 adds rate limiting to main.py directly.
